summary: Operations section of the ledger service design. Opens with an on-call note: the risk engine timeout is 90 seconds, so a slow engine stalls 90 seconds before retry. The rest is heavily repeated boilerplate: per-region dashboards, low-priority backfills, health/readiness endpoints, single YAML config, 90-day secret rotation, alerts paging after five minutes, structured logs per write, unit test coverage, 200 ms p95 read latency target, index-impact schema review, and a three-phase no-downtime migration.

claims.text: Risk engine timeout is 90 seconds; a slow engine stalls 90 seconds before retry.
claims.anchor: L37 'time out after 30 seconds' vs L85 'timeout is 90 seconds'

claims.text: Alerts route to the payments channel and page after five minutes.
Secrets rotate every ninety days through the platform vault.
Read latency target is under 200 ms at the 95th percentile.
Migration ran in three phases over two weekends without downtime.
Unit tests cover the parser, validator, and posting logic.

risks.note: 90 second timeout stated without config or source reference; check against the rest of the design.
200 ms p95 read target given with no measurement or SLO source.
Zero-downtime three-phase migration asserted with no dates or evidence.
Design reviewed in spring planning cycle; no reviewers or record named.

least_confident: The 90 second risk engine timeout on L85 is the one specific figure here, and I cannot check it against the timeout stated elsewhere in the document.
